data.summary: Level 3 certified Anaplan Model Builder with 5+ years overall experience and 3 years in Anaplan modelling, designing and developing scalable planning solutions across Sales Planning, Financial Planning, Supply Chain, Workforce. Strong at translating business requirements into modular model designs, reconciling data across systems, and delivering user-centric dashboards and workflows.

technical_skills: Anaplan modeling, including modules, lists, dashboards, and workflows.
all_skills: Anaplan modeling, including modules, lists, dashboards, and workflows.

responsibilities: Built an end-to-end sales planning solution to automate commission and incentive calculations and streamline pipeline, quota allocation, and attainment tracking. Delivered real-time visibility into payout projections, margin impact, and performance KPIs across regions, products, and sales reps, enabling Sales Leadership and Sales Ops to run faster and more controlled planning cycles.
Implemented complex payout logic supporting tiered commissions, flat-rate incentives, accelerators, caps/floors, and product-based eligibility rules.
Designed scalable model architecture using System modules for mappings (Rep → Region, Product → Category, Territory → Hierarchy) to ensure performance and maintainability.
Built interactive dashboards for quota vs attainment, pipeline tracking, and commission projections with drill-downs by region, product line, and rep.
Enabled what-if simulations for territory reassignment, quota changes, and new product launch impacts using scenario drivers and controlled inputs.

Supported reconciliation of commission outputs with HR/Finance records and improved accuracy through validation checks and exception reporting. Integrated CRM pipeline and master data using governed import flows and ensured data quality via staged Data Hub loads and validations.
Supported UAT execution, defect triage, and deployment readiness documentation, ensuring smooth rollout and user adoption.

experience.role: Associate Anaplan Model Builder – Production Support
responsibilities: Supported business-critical Anaplan models used for FP&A budgeting/forecasting, revenue planning, cost tracking, and operational performance reporting. Responsible for day-to-day monitoring, issue resolution, data load support, and minor enhancements to ensure stable operations and accurate planning outputs for Finance and Business teams.
Supported daily production activities by monitoring model health, resolving user queries, and ensuring planning inputs and reports were available as per business timelines.
Assisted in troubleshooting calculation issues, mapping mismatches, and access-related problems by reviewing module logic, system mappings, and import logs.
Supported periodic data refreshes for Actuals and master data (accounts, cost centers, business units, regions) through controlled import actions and processes.
Helped maintain Data Hub staging modules for structured loads and supported hub-to-spoke style data movement for reporting and planning consumption.
Supported month-end / forecast cycles by running standard processes such as Actuals load validation, version updates, and basic reconciliation checks against source extracts.
Delivered minor enhancements including adding new line items, updating dashboards, improving filters, creating saved views, and supporting usability improvements for end users.
Participated in UAT support by executing test cases, validating outputs, and tracking defects/enhancement requests through Jira.
Maintained support documentation such as runbooks/SOPs, recurring cycle steps, and known issue fixes to improve support consistency.
technologies: Anaplan (Modules, Lists, UX Dashboards, Actions/Processes, ALM)

projects.description: Built an end-to-end sales planning solution to automate commission and incentive calculations and streamline pipeline, quota allocation, and attainment tracking. Delivered real-time visibility into payout projections, margin impact, and performance KPIs across regions, products, and sales reps, enabling Sales Leadership and Sales Ops to run faster and more controlled planning cycles.

projects.name: Financial Planning & Budgeting Model (FP&A)
projects.description: Built a driver-based FP&A solution enabling budgeting, rolling forecasts, and variance analysis across business units. Improved transparency and cycle efficiency by centralizing planning inputs, standardizing calculation logic, and enabling multi-version comparisons for finance stakeholders.
technologies: Anaplan (Modules, Data Hub, Workflow, UX Dashboards)

projects.name: DataCore Validation (Banking Domain)
projects.description: The project focused on validating web and mobile applications to ensure functionality, usability, data accuracy, and overall system stability as per business and technical requirements. It involved end-to-end manual testing across multiple modules, including requirement analysis, test case preparation, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and backend data validation using SQL. The objective was to deliver high-quality releases by identifying critical defects early, improving test coverage, and ensuring a smooth user experience across web, Android, and iOS platforms.
